title: Save one main-state bit in an initialized G20 carry (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite construction certificate with a scoped written all-width proof, produced by Nick Petalas. For the released G20 scale-free port8 inverse column1 `(-1/4,0,-1,0,-1,0,0,-1)`, jointly encode the initialized quotient thresholds and active comparisons.

```diff
- 20 main-state bits in the cited separate quotient/comparison representation
+ 19 main-state bits from a 23,789-state active joint closure and four inactive flags

- 3,328 predecessor values in the cited unrestricted product-state row witness
+ at most 3,248 row-record values in this initialized joint representation
```

Both row-record alphabets still require twelve bits in an independent fixed-width slot. The domain and representation change; the predecessor's sharp unrestricted-domain result is retained. A mixed-radix history register gives an explicit literal inverse with allocated capacity `bit_length(3248^L-1)` for `L` rows, with its arithmetic separately charged.

Only `research/g20-initialized-joint-state/` is added. Search stopped at this first local improvement. The exact boundary, integer-prefix induction, packet and return, source identities and component ledger are in `PROOF.md`. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- Enumerate all 23,789 active joint states and all 761,248 transitions. A separate oracle appends bits to full integer prefixes and recomputes threshold states by direct integer division. It checks an actual prefix witness for every state and every outgoing edge.
- Check every inverse edge and source rank. The maximum active fiber is 203; four inactive comparison bits give at most `203*16=3248` record values.
- Check 707 canonical packets with a direct modular-inverse oracle, 5,184 dirty six-bit output cases, 32,768 arbitrary three-row streams, 21 complete long executions through 4,097 rows, empty input and ten rejecting controls.
- The warning-strict normal command passes locally in 2.962 seconds; the optimized command passes in 2.900 seconds. These are check durations, not a speedup claim. Generated source/code-bound receipts agree byte for byte. Both registered commands pass together; each has a 120-second timeout.
- Metadata, all ten committed package/input files and declared source ancestry pass at `c927c08dea4de4c83c30b6ad111e91e965120a0f`. The official export passes integrity checks. A sealed, read-only export runs with Git absent from PATH in both modes, with unchanged files and identical receipts.

From the repository root, use the exact local interpreter path below, or substitute CPython 3.12:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/g20-initialized-joint-state/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/g20-initialized-joint-state/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-initialized-joint-state
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/g20-initialized-joint-state --check-source-history
```

Expected markers: `PASS_G20_INITIALIZED_JOINT_STATE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Local environment is macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.15 and the standard library. The single consumed column catalogue is pinned to canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; predecessor scientific verifiers are not replayed.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The main-state count excludes two residue bits, one radix bit, the stream cursor, inputs, output, history, lookup scratch and static tables. An ideal direct packed table layout for this construction occupies 5,067,117 bytes before descriptors, alignment and addressing. That is a declared layout calculation, not an emitted packed backend or a Python heap measurement. Larger tables can outweigh the saved state bit. Mixed-radix history arithmetic also requires a physical implementation and tariff.

No total-workspace minimum, minimum reachable-state theorem, fixed-width history-bit saving, runtime improvement, physical tape/Boolean tariff, whole-G20 caller substitution, native/recursive invoice or supplier admission is supplied. The sample executable has a 4,097-row limit; the written induction covers arbitrary finite lengths. Immutable rows must remain available in reverse order. Invalid canonical inputs restore work and report invalidity; their packet bits are unspecified.

Precision, stock, tape, compiler, analytic/outer use and all five selected assumptions remain. Selected cold replay, native/compiler builds, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Price one actual packed forward/return lookup, including static storage, addressing, scratch and head return, against the separate quotient/comparison producer. A matched physical caller is missing.
2. Determine whether prefixes extendible to valid canonical inputs permit a further state or history reduction, with a proof covering every allowed low input and complete return. No continuation is reserved.

## Related open work

- [PR6531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6531) supplies the reversible-history contract and the 3,328-element unrestricted product-state witness. This changes initialized joint reachability and representation; it leaves that sharp theorem intact.
- [PR6503](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6503) supplies separate compact quotient machines. This constructs a joint raw-threshold/comparison machine for one column without auditing quotient minimization.
- [PR6474](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6474) supplies the interleaved carry identity and packet interface; this retains those semantics and low-input validity checks.
- [PR6558](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6558) packs phase, quotient, comparisons and residues across all released columns. This instead changes one column's initialized state space and inverse fibers. Their displayed register counts have different scopes; no competing full-register count or additional comparison computation is claimed.

Live open PRs, recent handoffs and reservation scopes were refreshed before committing. The completion refresh screened all fifteen other account open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. PR6558, already listed above, concerns the related full phase/residue representation across all columns. Its register counts have a different scope; no conflicting shared value was identified, and no additional computations checked another contribution. Main/merged searches covered the quantity, column and general joint-state question. Unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain overlap limits.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplies PR6531, PR6503, PR6474 and PR5820. Their retained ToikY, Tekalign, JoyboyBrian, Kyu, Nick Petalas and G20/native/ROW predecessors keep their credit. Finite-state reachability, carry invariants, predecessor ranks, mixed-radix coding and compute/copy/uncompute are classical. The new contribution is this initialized joint closure, its smaller representation and record alphabet, and its certificate and scoped proof. New work is Apache-2.0; general literature priority is unclaimed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19370121).

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `c927c08dea4de4c83c30b6ad111e91e965120a0f` in [Registered research packages run 41609714538](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609714538): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609714538/job/125828246414) in 4m12s and [replay (research/g20-initialized-joint-state)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41609714538/job/125830159774) in 1m51s. The completed checks were read once; run metadata confirms the matching head, completed status and successful conclusion.

Hosted replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized registered commands. Local registered checks, committed-byte/source-history checks and sealed read-only export replays also pass. CI certifies execution of the bounded finite closure, integer-prefix edge, inverse, packet/validity, restoration, control and receipt checks. The arbitrary-finite-length result rests on the written induction. Hosted success does not establish independent mathematical or formal proof-kernel acceptance, physical supplier admission or a complete multiplication theorem.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package.
